title.id: Emas Stagnan di Sesi Tokyo; Sorotan pada Makro & Inflasi
title.en: Gold Little Changed in Tokyo Session; Mining & Supply in Focus

lede.id: Harga emas spot relatif stagnan selama sesi Tokyo, ditutup di US$3.572,90 per troy ons dibandingkan US$3.573,70 saat pembukaan (07.00–16.00 WIB).
lede.en: Spot gold was little changed during the Tokyo session, ending at $3,572.90 an ounce versus $3,573.70 at the open (07:00–16:00 WIB).

title.id: Emas Turun Tipis di Sesi Sydney; Sorotan pada Tambang & Pasokan
title.en: Gold Edges Lower in Sydney Session; Mining & Supply in Focus

lede.id: Harga emas spot turun 0,13% selama sesi Sydney, dari US$3.573,70 menjadi US$3.569,00 per troy ons antara pukul 05.00 dan 14.00 WIB.
lede.en: Spot gold fell 0.13% during the Sydney session, slipping from $3,573.70 to $3,569.00 an ounce between 05:00 and 14:00 WIB.
